name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.

Esther's weight is immediately next to the angler who landed the Perch.
The angler who landed the Trout's weight is exactly 6 lb more than Mabel.

The catch with 8 lb and Esther are in the same family.
